title: DANZABOSS plan
description: Derived from spec.md. A tree of tasks; every leaf must carry a verification method (Upgrade #4). W1 (workstation design spec section 6) adds hierarchical ids, kind, size_est, depends_on, writes, flags.

spec_ref.description: path/hash of the spec this plan derives from

order.description: leaf ids in validated execution order (written by the workstation planner)

description.description: ONE concern; conjunction chains are rejected by the validator

size_est.description: estimated minutes; hard cap 30 (split larger tasks)

depends_on.description: task ids that must complete first (leaves only)

writes.description: files/areas touched; kept for wave planning

flags.description: hard-stop markers surfaced at planning time (Rules 13-15)
